description: PRD-203 — Auth Wrapper Migration. Roll the two well-built-but-barely-used auth wrappers (lib/api-auth.ts: withTenantAuth/withTenantAuthParams/withSuperAdmin/withSuperAdminParams/withAuth) out to all 107 app/api/**/route.ts files (only 12 use one today; ~95 hand-roll `getCurrentUser() + if(!user) return 401`). FIRST harden the wrappers to compose PRD-202's runWithTenantContextAsync (they only do the role check today — they do NOT bind tenant context): withTenantAuth binds user.tenantId, withSuperAdmin binds explicit null (cross-tenant system query), withAuth binds the host-resolved tenant. The lib/db.ts $use middleware warns (not throws) on an unbound context while TENANT_CONTEXT_STRICT is OFF, so the rollout is incremental and safe; the deploy flips strict ON once 107/107 are wrapped-or-allow-listed. Then delete the hand-rolled blocks; handlers read user/tenantId from the wrapper context arg. Fix two correctness bugs underneath: (1) getCurrentUser tenant resolution is host-blind and its email fallback was unscoped/ambiguity-blind — wire it to 205's ambiguity-aware canonical resolveTenant (already a delegator) and consume the typed ambiguous result as 403; add a typed UserNotProvisionedError (->409) for the Clerk user.created race; (2) customer/profile does a no-tenant findFirst({where:{email}}) on GET+PATCH = cross-tenant leak — wrap it in withAuth so the now-bound host tenant auto-scopes the users lookup. Add a ts-morph CI gate (scripts/check-auth-wrappers.ts + pnpm check:auth-wrappers) that fails the build on any unwrapped, non-allow-listed handler. STACKED on ralph/prd-205 @ 06674ce (chain 202->205->203): strict deps PRD-202 (runWithTenantContextAsync + the warn/throw policy) + PRD-205 (canonical resolver). Soft overlap with PRD-204 (validation runs inside the wrapped handler; both touch the same route files — reconcile at merge).

userStories.title: Harden auth wrappers to compose tenant-context binding (AC-1b)
userStories.description: As the platform, every wrapped handler must run inside one bound tenant scope so its Prisma calls auto-scope (and the strict-mode flip is safe). The wrappers currently only do the role check — make them compose PRD-202's runWithTenantContextAsync. No route bodies change yet.
acceptanceCriteria: withTenantAuth / withTenantAuthParams run the handler inside runWithTenantContextAsync(user.tenantId, () => handler(...)) — the authenticated admin's own tenant is bound for the whole handler (asserted non-null before binding)

withSuperAdmin / withSuperAdminParams run the handler inside runWithTenantContextAsync(null, () => handler(...)) — an EXPLICIT null (deliberate cross-tenant system query); hasTenantContext() is true so the lib/db.ts middleware allows unscoped reads rather than treating it as the implicit-unbound leak

withAuth resolves the request/host tenant (getTenantFromRequest, the same pure lookup withTenantContext uses) and runs the handler inside runWithTenantContextAsync(hostTenant?.id ?? null, ...) — so storefront customer routes (customer/profile, orders, cart) auto-scope to the storefront tenant; a customer has no Clerk org so user.tenantId is not used here
No setTenantContext/enterWith reintroduced; binding is via runWithTenantContextAsync only; error path still funnels through apiError()

Unit tests (tests/unit/api-auth.test.ts) with getCurrentUser + getTenantFromRequest + runWithTenantContextAsync mocked/spied: each wrapper binds the expected tenantId (user.tenantId | null | host id) before invoking the handler; no-user->401; wrong-role->401; withTenantAuth missing tenantId->403
Tests pass
Typecheck passes
